_comment: CANDIDATE, added 2026-09-24 to measure - not a recommendation. See docs/model-learnings.md.
Free: no charge per token. The limits are the catch - 1,000 requests a day once $10 of
credit has ever been bought (50 before), 20 a minute, and free providers throttle hard
(429 Provider returned error). One real fallback session made 192 requests, so a
day of allowance is a few sessions at most. Every tier on the one free model.
